## Checks
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Emulator end-to-end (`npm run test:xr`), if the reading flow changed
- [ ] Tried on a Quest (say which), if rendering or input changed
- [ ] New readings cite one rule and pass the banned-claims filter
- [ ] New assets are listed in `CREDITS.md` with their licence
